landing.hero_title: Fast Meter Invoicing, Directly to Tenants via LINE

landing.features_tax_desc: Consolidate property revenues and expenses, separating income into Section 40(5) and 40(8) for tax compliance.

test_connection.title: Supabase Connection Diagnostics
test_connection.subtitle: This page helps you verify the connection between the HorSet application and your local or cloud Supabase database.
test_connection.testing: Sending request to verify database connection...
test_connection.sql_advice: 💡 Recommendation: If database connection is successful but tables cannot be loaded, you might not have run the SQL script in your Supabase SQL Editor. Follow the instructions below.
test_connection.step1_desc: If you don't have a project yet, go to Supabase.com, sign up, and create a new project.
test_connection.step2_desc: Go to your Supabase project 👉 Settings > API, copy the keys, and edit the .env file in your root folder:
test_connection.step3_desc: Go to Supabase 👉 SQL Editor, select "New query", paste the entire contents of schema.sql, and click "Run" to set up tables, RLS policies, and triggers.
test_connection.step4_desc: Once the above steps are completed, click "Retest" above to verify the database connection is 100% operational.

tax_page.item_staff_wages_desc: Monthly wages for cleaners, daily rates for maintenance technicians, or meter-reading staff.
tax_page.item_internet_desc: Monthly high-speed broadband subscription fees for sharing Wi-Fi with residents.
tax_page.item_supplies_desc: Purchasing replacement bulbs for hallways, water filters, floor cleaner chemicals for common areas.
tax_page.guide_408_recommend_desc: File under this category when the expense directly supports utility systems or cleaning/maintenance. These are operational expenses that recur frequently.
tax_page.expense_ledger_title: Actual Expense Ledger for Tax Year {year}
tax_page.expense_ledger_subtitle: Record actual expenses to claim documented tax deductions (recommended when actual expenses exceed the flat rate).

tax_page.no_expenses_recorded: No actual expenses recorded for tax year {year}
tax_page.no_expenses_recorded_desc: Start recording expenses related to dormitory care and operations (such as repairs and utility bills) to support actual tax deductions.
tax_page.monthly_summary_subtitle: Summary of actual received income by tax category to verify the completeness of monthly estimates.
tax_page.advance_rent_subtitle: For leases starting in tax year {year}, advance rent is recorded as Section 40(5) income to recognize taxable revenue in the initial contract year according to tax laws.
tax_page.contracts_started_count: Number of contracts started in this tax year: {count} items
tax_page.no_new_contracts: No new leases started in tax year {year}
tax_page.no_new_contracts_desc: When new tenants are registered with contract start dates in this tax year, their accumulated advance rent will automatically be displayed here.
tax_page.pnd94_filing_period_desc: Typically submitted between July and September of that year as an advance tax payment for first-half earnings.
tax_page.pnd90_filing_period_desc: Submitted between January and March of the following year. Taxes paid under P.N.D. 94 can be credited against this final amount.
tax_page.modal_expense_name_placeholder: e.g. painting rooms, government water bills
tax_page.modal_date_hint: Used to separate actual mid-year (Jan-Jun) expenses for P.N.D. 94 accuracy, rather than simply dividing the annual total by 2.
tax_page.modal_cat_405_hint: Pertaining to physical buildings, structures, and main fixtures
tax_page.modal_cat_408_hint: Pertaining to services, common utilities, and maintenance
tax_page.modal_guidance_deductible_title_prefix: Items deductible as actual expenses for
tax_page.modal_rent_item1_desc: repainting building exterior, roofing repairs, elevator maintenance, foundation work
tax_page.modal_rent_item2_desc: interest on bank loans taken for land purchase, building construction or renovation
tax_page.modal_rent_item3_desc: and other government fees directly related to rental properties
tax_page.modal_rent_item4_desc: fire/property damage insurance policies on the structure
tax_page.modal_rent_tip: 💡 The Revenue Department allows a flat 30% deduction. If your actual expenses are less, claiming the flat rate is recommended for maximum tax savings.
tax_page.modal_util_item1_desc: master water/electricity bills paid directly to authorities (excludes amounts billed to tenants)
tax_page.modal_util_item2_desc: salaries or service contracts for common-area maintenance
tax_page.modal_util_item3_desc: hallway bulbs, floor cleaning agents, replacement switches, hoses
tax_page.modal_util_item4_desc: and common area wastewater treatment costs
tax_page.modal_util_tip: 💡 The Revenue Department allows a flat 60% deduction. If your actual expenses are less, claiming the flat rate is recommended for maximum tax savings.
